articles.headline: MultiSensor AI Deepens Vibration Coverage in Condition Intelligence Solution through Collaboration with Broadsens
articles.summary: MultiSensor AI announced expanded vibration-monitoring capability through Broadsens integration into MSAI Connect and planned demonstrations. This is a product/collaboration announcement, not evidence that anticipated customer sales or reliability outcomes were realized.
